data: Follow-on tests for detection of TB drug resistance
Low-complexity automated NAATs Xpert® MTB/XDR (Cepheid) for detection of resistance to isoniazid and second-line anti-TB agents
Line probe assays (LPAs) for GenoType® MTBDRplus v1 and v2; and GenoType detection of TB drug resistance MTBDRsl (Hain Lifescience/Bruker) Genoscholar™ NTM+MDRTB II and Genoscholar PZA-TB II (Nipro)
